title_format.explanation: The title uses a lowercase type, optional scope/!, and ': '.

summary-section.explanation: The body includes a populated level-two Summary section.

review-coverage.explanation: The review refers only to unseen discussion and unspecified items, so it cannot be tied to specific changes in the patches.

title_meaningful.explanation: The title names a concrete, intelligible change.

title_diff_consistency.explanation: The title agrees with the reference change and patch.

description_present.explanation: The description contains substantive change information.

rationale.explanation: The rationale explains the concrete problem motivating the reference change.

changes_described.explanation: The description states concrete implementation changes.

description_title_consistency.explanation: The description and meaningful title describe the same change.

description_commit_consistency.explanation: The description covers the changes named by every commit.

description_diff_consistency.explanation: The summary covers all substantive changes in the patches.

limitations.explanation: The description names relevant scope limits or risks.

breaking_changes.explanation: No public field or configuration entrypoint is removed in this family; any behavior changes and scope risks are still documented in the reference text.

testing.explanation: The description gives a relevant validation plan, without claiming execution.

change_triviality.explanation: src/totals.py removes the repeated word 'the' from a comment. The diff shows no change to any executable line, so there is no runtime or interface effect.
